proof_roadmap: Localisation of the double dual map (proof lines 5247-5251).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that reflexivity of a finite module over a Noetherian domain can be checked at all primes, or equivalently at all maximal ideals. The proof identifies the localisation of the natural map to the double dual at a prime with the corresponding natural map for the localised module over the localised ring, using that the double dual is computed by Hom out of a finitely presented module, and then applies the standard criterion that vanishing or invertibility of a module map can be tested locally at the primes.
